beats.say: Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system and the first to form.
Its mass is nearly two point five times all other planets combined.
The planet is so vast that its diameter is eleven times that of Earth.
Jupiter is the third brightest natural object in the night sky.
It has at least one hundred and fifteen moons, including Ganymede.
Ganymede is actually larger than the planet Mercury.
Which moon in our solar system is your favourite?

facts: Jupiter is the fifth planet from the Sun and the largest in the Solar System.
Jupiter has a mass nearly 2.5 times that of all the other planets in the Solar System combined.
The diameter of Jupiter is 11 times that of Earth.
Jupiter is the third-brightest natural object in the Earth's night sky after the Moon and Venus.
Jupiter was the first of the Sun's planets to form.
At least 115 moons orbit the planet.
Ganymede is larger than the planet Mercury.

hi.title: बृहस्पति: सबसे बड़ा ग्रह कौन सा है? 🪐
